claims.promise: Import a BeerXML recipe through the system document picker so the brewer can start from an existing recipe instead of retyping it.

evidence.finding: The complaint scan sampled 3 critical BeerSmith reviews; one states: "Loses recipes. No import of beer.xml files". The BeerXML site defines recipe exchange as its primary purpose.

claims.deferredReason: BeerXML import has not been implemented or tested against competitor-exported fixtures.

claims.promise: Solve a style-targeted grain bill and carry its calculated ingredient, water and hop plan into the timed brew-day steps.

evidence.finding: "all grain brewing calculator" returned a candidate verdict, with 46 of 50 visible titles hand-classified on-job.

claims.deferredReason: The recipe solver, schedule and independent numerical fixtures have not been implemented.

claims.promise: Show the selected Tinseth model and per-addition IBU contribution rather than presenting a bitterness estimate with no named method.

evidence.finding: A sampled brewing-calculator review says its Brix/Plato/SG conversion is incorrect; the published Brewer's Friend fixture labels its result "IBU (tinseth): 53.91".

claims.deferredReason: Tinseth calculations and alternative-model disclosure have not been implemented.

claims.promise: Calculate target-profile salt additions and a clearly labelled Palmer residual-alkalinity mash-pH estimate for the selected recipe.

evidence.finding: "brewing water chemistry" returned a mixed scan result with 21 rated listings, while title hand-classification found only 9 of 50 results on brewing-water chemistry.

claims.deferredReason: Water-ion calculations and malt/water fixtures have not been implemented or validated.

claims.promise: Carry the recipe through fermentation-temperature steps, yeast-pitch guidance and either priming-sugar or keg-carbonation instructions.

evidence.finding: The recipe-to-packaging workflow is coherent, but the carbonation-calculator search had only 3 rated results among 12 visible, so this subfeature lacks independent demand evidence.

claims.deferredReason: Pitch, fermentation and packaging models need named references and independent test fixtures.

claims.promise: Resume an active brew-day run and notify the brewer when its next timed step is due.

evidence.finding: "brew day app" returned a mixed scan result and 25 of 30 visible cards were hand-classified as brewing-related.

claims.deferredReason: The notification lifecycle, timer recovery and opt-in behavior have not been implemented.

claims.promise: Export the resolved recipe as BeerXML and as a printable, shareable PDF containing the named calculation models and timed brew-day and packaging instructions.

comparison.limitation: A sampled critical review reports "No import of beer.xml files" and recipe loss; this is one review, not a claim about every user's experience.

evidence.finding: BeerXML v1 states that recipe exchange is its primary purpose; the sampled BeerSmith critical review says "No import of beer.xml files".

proof.assertion: A source review finds ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT and PdfDocument in the exporter; an export test reads the generated BeerXML and PDF and verifies the fixture's model-labelled recipe and schedule.
